strings.en: This ship will finish that enemy off.
All hands, I hope to see you fight well.
All hands, live up to Rätsel's hopes!
Don't let it get near this ship!
Shoot it down before it pulls that trick!
This ship will cut open our escape route!
Gadisword's new model...!/　We won't hand over the Ariard!
No need to hold back./　There's no human aboard that unit.
No life signs. Shoot it down.
All hands, prepare for anti-ship combat!
Target: Zeranio-class! Prepare for anti-ship combat!
We're destroying the Zovorg units ahead!
We're destroying the Golaikunru units ahead!
Don't let the Fury units approach!
We're engaging the Fury units ahead!
We're engaging the Gadisword units ahead!
This ship will destroy the commander unit!
This ship will wipe out the Demons!
Report the damage! Hurry with damage control!
If we sink here,/　how will we ever face Rätsel?!
Thicken the barrage! Keep them back!
We can't end here!/　Not until our duty is done!
Don't let up! A half-hearted defense will only backfire!
That won't be enough to sink the Kurogane.
So they're concentrating on this ship...!
We've been through hell/　more times than we can count.
Don't waste the time Raul and the others bought us!
We can't withdraw from here unless we drive it off!
Put up a barrage! Keep the commander unit in check!
I have no interest in hearing you laugh!
Make sure you destroy the Zovorg units!
This ship isn't so soft that one unit can sink it!
Don't let the Zeranio-class have its way!
Don't let the Demons get any closer!
Take evasive action and return fire!
All turrets, keep the enemy at bay.
Resistance is light, but stay alert.
Damn that black Raftclans.../　Does it mean to sink this ship first...?!
Don't let the Gadisword commander unit approach!
Don't fall behind the Zeranio-class in a ship battle!
Don't let the Gadisword units approach.
To think the Demons got their teeth in us...!
So the Demons are after this ship.
I won't let a ship entrusted to us/　by Rätsel come to harm.
Keep the Demon away just like that.
The field went up just in time.
You'd better think of another move.
All we can do is defend...!
Full speed ahead! Cover our units!
Use this ship as a shield!
We've come this far./　We can't lose the Granteed now!
Be a shield for the Bellzelute!
Upper shock cannons 1 and 2! Stand by!
Upper shock cannons, prepare to fire!
Fire a full barrage ahead, then use/　the bow's Giant Rotating Ram!
Elevation error corrected!/　All forward guns, stand by!
Tesla Drive to maximum output!/　Overboost!!
